Do you have strong location preferences? This map tracks the locations of postings on the American Economic Association's [Job Openings for Economics](https://www.aeaweb.org/joe/listings) in case you do. (I of course use the [equal earth map projection](https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/09/1168284) to comply with the UN.)
